items.text: Senate Republicans re-elected John Thune as their leader by secret ballot; he ran unopposed and will lead them in the minority from January. Sen. Ron Johnson, who had sought a delay, walked out as voting began.

Trump said the US has already won the Iran war and now wants “total victory”. At the G7 in Paris, Rubio said the US is not on a path to restart a hot war and will keep squeezing Iran’s economy rather than accept a “stupid deal” (per Axios, cited by Fox). Iran threatened to strike US bases in Europe if they are used to attack it.
items.notes: Closes W-261106-03. Iran Europe-bases threat from Times of Israel live-blog headline only.

items.text: Treasury Secretary Bessent has moved from his Washington home to a military base after Iranian threats against his life, the New York Times reported; a senior official told Fox the plotting had reached an advanced stage, and Rubio and Stephen Miller have also moved to protected housing. Iran has previously denied plotting attacks on US soil.
An oil tanker caught fire after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iran’s IRGC (via AP); UKMTO reported a tanker incident but it is unclear whether it is the same ship.

Nvidia’s board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang, possibly within days, the Wall Street Journal reported, after the New York Times reported a second alleged affair, with a senior Nvidia executive. No decision had been confirmed. Shares rose nearly 5% in regular trading, then fell about 7.5% after hours; House Republicans are threatening to subpoena Huang.
items.outlet: ABC7 / San Francisco Standard (citing WSJ, NYT)

items.text: Reuters found procurement records showing an Entity-Listed Chinese military university bought Nvidia H200 chips through a reseller without a licence, and flagged 26 similar records. Senators Warren and Coons asked the administration to preserve records on H200 export licensing to China.
items.notes: Read via AI Weekly summary; original Reuters/Al Jazeera pages not reachable.

items.text: With about a month to the government funding deadline, Congress is far from a spending deal, the Washington Post reported; Bloomberg reported Democrats are weighing using funding to press for an end to the Iran war.
items.notes: Headlines only; full articles not reachable.

items.text: CISA added a critical (CVSS 9.8) GPUStack authentication flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue, with a Nov 12 deadline for federal agencies to fix it.
